# Firebase Hosting Basics

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — deploys and configures classic Firebase Hosting for static websites, SPAs, and microservices: `firebase.json` configuration (public dirs, redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), deploys, preview channels, releases, GitHub Actions integration, local emulation, and dynamic content via Cloud Functions or Cloud Run. Important distinction: this is classic Firebase Hosting (CDN, full CLI control) — not the published firebase-app-hosting-basics fiche, which covers Firebase App Hosting (Next.js/SSR, automated git-push deploys); the skill itself includes a Hosting-vs-App-Hosting decision table. Requires a Google account with Firebase enabled; Hosting usage is billed on Google's paid tiers beyond the free allowance — a paid service for real projects. By @firebase, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
